title: Lingotorte as-is user journey (pass 2)
description: One observed learner workflow through the current app. Steps reference pass-1 structure IDs (controls, views, routes) so the validator can detect drift. Every journey and every non-trivial claim carries an evidence label.

id.description: Stable journey id, also the file name.

goal.description: What the learner is trying to achieve, in their words.

variants.description: Alternative paths through the same goal that this journey does not walk (name + where they diverge).

divergesAt.description: Step id where the variant branches off.

persisted.description: Durable learner-state effects of the whole journey (domain terms, no values).

observations.description: UX facts noticed while walking the journey that are not themselves steps. Neutral: no proposals here.

kind.description: observed-live: a recorded live browser run; source-reading: traced in code; jsdom-test: exercised by a vitest/JSDOM test; inference: not verified.

ref.description: Where the evidence lives (doc path, test file, run id).

sourceRef.description: path:line into the repo; validated against the live tree.

target.description: Pass-1 control id (structure.yaml controls[].id). Required for click/key/type/file-input/paste/select-text.

view.description: Pass-1 view id where the step's interactions happen. A nav click that opens this view belongs to the step (it is counted as a view switch against the previous step's end view).

userSees.description: What is on screen that matters for this step (exact visible strings in quotes when they are app text).

decision.description: Present when the learner must choose between options at this step.

feedback.description: The app's visible/announced response (toast, banner, focus move, navigation, disabled state).

persists.description: What becomes durable learner state at this step (domain terms, no values).

api.description: Service routes hit (METHOD /api/path), from structure.yaml api.routes.

focusAfter.description: Where keyboard focus lands after the step (control id, 'body' = lost, or a free description).

modal.description: True when the step blocks the rest of the UI (dialog, confirm).

navigatesTo.description: View id when the APP changes view as a result of the step (not the learner clicking nav).
